diversity_gate_revision.motivation: The version 2 views passed every signal, throughput, graph, and cross-view stability check but failed the 0.90 unique-fraction gate. Each still contained more than six times the unique products needed for one 512-member bank. The revised gate measures both absolute candidate support and protection against sampling collapse.
diversity_gate_revision.decision_alignment: The count gate requires at least four unique eligible-pool candidates per bank member before deduplication; the fraction gate rules out a duplicate-dominated sampler.
diversity_gate_revision.validation_rule: Apply the revised gate to two new independent views. The failed version 2 views cannot qualify version 3.

unchanged_requirements: All remaining per-view gates, two-view gates, target scoring semantics, graph measurements, bank size, construction rules, and confirmation thresholds remain as frozen in MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT.json, MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT_V2.json, and BANK_CONSTRUCTION_CONTRACT.json.
